page.overview:
Who is Namine Tasil?

She is the eldest daughter of Quillin Tasil. Her mother was one of the most successful silk merchants in Bandar Eban. Since her father is still alive, it can be assumed that Namine is a relatively young Aes Sedai.

She went to the White Tower and joined the Brown Ajah, settling down as a Librarian. Cadsuane Melaidhrin was impressed with Namine's understanding of current events and followed the link down to her father, an Andoran innkeeper in Bandar Eban, who became one of her eyes-and-ears.

Category:Librarians Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
